title: AliExpress: 17% Cashback on Affiliated Items ($30 Cap Per Order) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 17% Cashback on Affiliated Items ($30 Cap Per Order) @ TopCashback AU

[jazlet] The cap sucks.
Maybe people should just switch to TCB UK for all purchases.
They obviously see no reason to entice us with larger caps (or uncapped) as people are spending too much as it is with the cap in place.
[aragornelessar] TCB UK also gives you an option to mark your click through as a purchase - so if you're like me, you don't need to wonder/remember if you bought anything
[morphio] Wonder why UK is so much better than our one :(
[Dollar Dreamer] We need more Indians, Africans and Middle Eastern people to migrate here to push our population to around 50 million before we can enjoy developers, suppliers, manufacturers to give us the same discounts and features as the rest of the world like UK, USA and many European countries. Our population is too low and White Australians are just not having 7 babies per family like our migrant friends. Vote for pro migrant policies so we can start increasing our population and get economies of scale thus get better products and services in Australia.
[TerryTightwad] I heard its because the import tax is high so higher commission with that one.
[Clear] Significantly larger market than Australia. More customers means better promotions.
[QuickToThePointless] the 6 month payout timeframe sucks more!
[Steven123] Does anyone know how to check click history on tcb? I did not receive any cashback at all in 16 hours now. First time issue.
[DogeConomy] Account -> Earnings -> Clicks to merchants
[mblack77] I wouldn’t touch AliExpress with a barge pole. Their courier dumped my package outside overnight which was stolen before I had a chance to collect it. AliExpress refused to address the evidence (caught on camera) and dismissed my request for a refund. I ended up having to force it via a chargeback from my bank. Never again.
[ChipsChicky] what was the value of items? Been with them for ages and have many refunds processed without any issues and evidence.
[fedwood] I was told by a PayPal employee that they ignore PayPal in disputes, so any general consumer has no chance.
[poxy001] Completely unfair but I dont blame them for avoiding paypal.
[davidl222222] you can still buy Netac ram and get 17% cashback + code, maybe combined with the PayPal deal?
[dufflover] I found for an item it has a very large coins discount of like 30-50% (via the app only) and it was only there for maybe 24-36 hours, before changing back to a pretty low discount. Luckily I jumped on it at the good discount and 20% TCB. Wonder if it lined up to something, to predict better in future.
[ycon] Tracked immediately after I ordered, must set reminder for self to "Mark as received". Thanks
[zer0Cash] any else having issues logging into TCB? I tried resetting password but still unable to login.. hmmm
[TerryTightwad] I noticed it's been logging out on multiple devices
[zer0Cash] yeh same.. logged a services ticket.. see how long it takes to resolve.. otherwise my cashback $ balance is goneskis…
[dragond] My cashback didn’t track :( I had the Topcashback app installed and opened AliExpress in Safari
